items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: Bassist John Beal is the very definition of a versatile working musician. He has spent seven decades playing onstage and in studios with the likes of Kenny Davern...

ctx.x: And Kenny. Kenny was one of a kind.
I’ll say. I miss him. We miss him. A lot of people miss Kenny. Yeah. All right man.
All right. Thank you very much.
